sentences.text:
Sukhnandan Jain vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 March,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:10866
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Suresh Kumar Kait,
 Chief Justice
 &
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Vivek Jain
 On The 7 th Of March, 2025
 Writ Appeal No. 623 of 2025
 Sukhnandan Jain
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Mahendra Pateria with Shri Vishal Pateriya, Ad
 appellant.
 Shri Abhijeet Awasthi, Deputy Advocate 
 respondents/State.
 Order

Per: Hon'ble Shri Justice Suresh Kumar Kait, Chief Justice The instant appeal is directed against the order dated 24.02.2025 passed by the learned Single Judge in W.P. No. 27170 of 2018 whereby the interim order was vacated.

2. The appellant filed the writ petition stating that in respect of the alleged shortage of food articles,
the respondents are themselves responsible for not taking preventive measures and proper arrangements for avoiding theft of food article during transit and damage caused to the food article due to heavy rain as the food articles were lying in the open sky and there were no safety NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:10866 2 WA-623-2025 measures of keeping the food articles safely and further there were no proper arrangement for avoiding theft of food articles in the dead of night by the miscreants and reduction in the weight of the food articles due to heat of the summer season and therefore for that reason and for the other reasons mentioned in the petition, the writ petitioner cannot be made responsible for the shortage in any manner and therefore, the impugned order is absolutely arbitrary and illegal and cannot sustain in the eyes of law and is liable to be quashed.
3. The writ petition was filed in the year 2018 and the interim order was granted by the writ court not to register FIR, vide order dated 30.11.2018.

Till date we are not aware of the fact as to what Sukhnandan Jain vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156875095/
1 happened in the case and who are the persons responsible as there is no investigation due to stay order that was prevailing.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
When the writ petition came up for hearing, Shri Abhishek Pandey,
Advocate for petitioner appeared on 24.02.2025, however, the counsel who had filed the writ petition, was not available, therefore, the interim order was vacated.
4. The writ petition is pending challenging the order of the respondents whereby the authorities have directed to register an FIR.

Since on the said issue till date there is no investigation as to who is responsible, we hereby direct the respondents/authorities to register an FIR in the case and investigate the matter and take action as per law.

5. It is made clear that if the police authorities come to a conclusion that custodial interrogation is necessary, to this effect the said authorities shall issue one week's notice to the appellant and if the appellant/writ petitioner is NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:10866 3 WA-623-2025 aggrieved by the same, he may challenge the same before the appropriate forum or may seek other remedies.
6. Accordingly, the writ appeal is disposed of.
In view of the order passed today, nothing remains in the writ petition and the writ petition also stands disposed of.
(SURESH KUMAR KAIT) (VIVE  CHIEF JUSTICE JU  MSP Sukhnandan Jain vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156875095/
